messages:
rosie: Noticed a spike in pending GPU joins in eu2 after tonight's firewall tightening at 02:15. Nodes failing during bootstrap with KMS errors.

dan: Which rule changed? link?

rosie: https://git.internal/r/redwood/network/commit/ee7c1f  - outbound 443 was limited to a slim CIDR list for control-plane. I think we clipped the privatelink ENI range.

peter: sample errors: `ERROR keystore-proxy: dial tcp 10.20.15.9:443: connection refused` and then `AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt` when fallback hits public KMS.

ops-bot: [ALERT] autoscale: 30 warmpool joins pending in eu2; avg bootstrap time 14m (baseline 2m).

dan: rollback or allowlist? Security?

security: temporary allowlist for privatelink ENI CIDR approved for 20m, must be documented. Create incident ticket.

rosie: Applying allowlist now. Patch: add allow 10.20.12.0/22:443 before deny.

deploy-bot: network rollback/patch applied.

ops-bot: [INFO] connectivity restored to privatelink ENIs. 22/30 nodes retried, 18 joined.

peter: we also saw elevated KMS QPS as nodes retried; wallet hit a small bill bump for cross-region decrypts when fallback used. rough est $420.

dan: follow-ups: 1) add control-plane privatelink probe to firewall CI, 2) ban CIDR-only rules that can affect shared ENIs, prefer tag-based allow, 3) incident postmortem.

rosie: opening I-2026-081 and adding logs + policy diff to the ticket.

security: include an action to require network PRs that change outbound rules to run a privatelink reachability test.

ops-bot: Incident I-2026-081 status -> mitigated. Postmortem due in 72h.

dan: nice quick recovery. will land CI test and update runbook. :thumbsup:
